idea: A governed autonomous agentic business and project environment
perfectedState: Business and child-project agents inherit verified governance, knowledge, brand, security, operational, and release controls while failures route through evidence-backed recovery and learning.

requirements.statement: Acquire authoritative business and project context
Child projects inherit scoped constitutional controls
Failures route through safe diagnosis and workaround escalation
Produce an executable dependency-safe implementation plan

tasks.action: Resolve canonical business and project sources
tasks.acceptance: Every material claim has provenance or UNKNOWN state
tasks.branch: IF sources conflict THEN fail closed and route to authority resolution
tasks.workaround: Search alternate canonical surface and compare timestamps
tasks.escalation: Ask source owner only after evidence routes are exhausted

tasks.rationale: Child projects need consistent but non-global constraints
tasks.acceptance: Manifest contains provenance, scope, version, and conflict rules
tasks.failure: Authority fork or hidden global override
tasks.branch: IF authority forks THEN stop affected branch and reconcile precedence
tasks.workaround: Narrow inheritance scope or wrap incompatible rule
tasks.fallback: Use explicit project-local rule with conflict recorded
tasks.escalation: Request owner decision for irreducible authority conflict

tasks.acceptance: Retry, diagnosis, alternate capability, surface change, adaptation, escalation, and abort are explicit
tasks.branch: IF retry repeats the same fingerprint THEN diagnose and change route
tasks.workaround: Advance through the ordered workaround ladder
tasks.escalation: Privileged request then human decision at final boundary

tasks.action: Compile and validate the final implementation DAG
tasks.rationale: The perfected model must become executable work
tasks.acceptance: No cycles, orphans, dangling edges, write collisions, or evidence-free tasks
tasks.branch: IF validation is BLOCKED THEN convert every finding to a repair task and revalidate
tasks.workaround: Re-decompose non-atomic nodes and research missing capabilities
tasks.fallback: Emit only verified executable subset with blocked branches
tasks.escalation: Human decision only for irreducible authority or privileged operation

residualRisks: Live connector privileges remain environment-specific and require runtime proof
